text:
Avery Collins: Hi folks  planning parental leave starting Jan 8 for ~12 weeks. Two quick asks: can we get a short-term childcare advance (not reimbursement) for the first month while receipts are pending? Also, need cover for approvals and my recurring customer demo on week 3.

people-ops-bot: Hi Avery! See parental leave options here: https://intranet.redwood/people/parental-benefits. We support Backup Care reimbursements and occasional advances; please file the parental intake form and select 'advance request' to start.

Darrin Holt: @Avery Finance can issue a one-time childcare advance up to $2,000 for qualifying cases. Requirements: completed intake form, expected receipts within 30 days, and manager sign-off. We'll process advances as payroll-adjusted non-taxable if receipts are provided; otherwise may be treated as a taxable advance.

Maya Singh: I can cover the customer demo week 3 and take your recurring syncs weeks 1-4. @Avery please add a runbook link and a short list of blockers so I can prep.

Avery Collins: Thanks Maya. I'll list current PRs and mark owners tonight. Quick Q Darrin: what's the turnaround if I request an advance today?

Finance Ops: Typical turnaround is 5-7 business days after intake + manager approval. If you need same-week funding, add "expedite" in the intake notes and tag @Finance Ops; we may be able to do 2-3 business days.

Darrin Holt: Also note legal requires a written attestation if the advance exceeds $1,000 for audit purposes. Attach a short note in the intake form.

Legal Bot: For any alternate signer changes on vendor approvals: low-dollar (<$10k) approver swaps can be set via the Approvals tool. For contract-level changes or signature delegations, file a Delegation of Authority request.

Avery Collins: Can we set an alternate signer for budget approvals under $5k? I often approve small travel/contract invoices.

Legal Bot: Yes. Use Approvals > Delegations and add @Maya Singh as alternate for amounts <= $5k. Keep a pinned comment in the delegation noting dates of coverage.

IT Helpdesk: FYI if you want to delegate access to the analytics dashboard for emergency lookups, create a temporary viewer link and add the alternate owner. We can enable 30-day links.

Avery Collins: Great — filing the intake now and selecting the advance option. I'll attach manager sign-off and a short attestation. Will post confirmation here when submitted. Thanks all :raised_hands:
